qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Colossal global scale economies across 190+ countries reaching 3.4 billion daily consumers. Portfolio of 30 power brands (Dove, Rexona, Knorr, Hellmann's, Domestos, Omo) generates 70%+ of group revenue with superior retail distribution shelf-space lock-in. Demonstrated pricing power by passing double-digit inflation through to pricing in 2021-2023, subsequently restoring positive volume growth and 18-24% GAAP ROIC. Primary risks include private-label competition in home care/dressings and emerging market currency volatility.
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Global consumer staple powerhouse with ~20% GAAP ROIC and 96% FCF conversion. Management's Growth Action Plan is sharpening focus on 30 power brands while carving out Ice Cream and cutting bureaucratic bloat. Balance sheet is well-supported with 9x interest coverage and net debt repayable in <2.5 years of FCF. [5-10Y g: organic volume 2.0% + price/mix 2.0% + margin expansion / buybacks 1.5%]
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is 19.7% (2022: 24.4%, 2023: 20.2%, 2024: 18.3%, 2025: 19.2%). Multi-year FCF conversion averages 95.7% (€6.7B-€8.1B annual owner FCF). Strong pricing power confirmed by passing severe 2022-2023 commodity inflation via 11-13% price hikes before pivoting back to positive volume in 2024-2025. Prudent capital allocation with tea (ekaterra) sold and ice cream demerger underway.
